name: workbench
description: Five independent explicit Workbench skills for evidence-backed analysis, task planning, Sol/high multi-agent execution, connected Wiki curation, and integrated-change validation.

interface.shortDescription: Independent tools for software change analysis and execution.
interface.longDescription: Workbench provides five independently useful, explicitly invoked skills. Analyze a change, create a task plan, coordinate task packets through parallel GPT-5.6 Sol/high workers in isolated Git worktrees, curate one canonical Wiki within existing project knowledge, or review one exact integrated Git change. No skill requires another Workbench skill.
defaultPrompt: Use $workbench:shape to investigate this software change and return a standalone report.
Use $workbench:prepare to create an isolated execution plan from this change definition.
Use $workbench:execute-task to run this plan through parallel GPT-5.6 Sol/high workers.
